text:
amanda_cs: Quick kickoff for Vanguard dedicated warmup — we need a clear checklist for quota scheduling, autoscale targets, and fallback behavior. Target steady-state: 10k QPS (token-gen path). Ramp window: 48h. Who owns what?

ben_sre: I can own the autoscaler config and smoke tests. Thinking 6-step ramp  (5%,15%,30%,50%,75%,100%) over 48h with soak at each step. Need max replicas and GPU util targets.

amanda_cs: thanks. For quota, Vanguard asked for a soft quota increase at start of ramp and final commit at day2. marisol — can you confirm governance approval?

marisol_csm: looping in Vanguard contact (lee.v) on the call. They want a warmup doc and a contact for 24/7 paging during the first 72h. I'll own enablement + customer comms.

ben_sre: proposed autoscale knobs:
```
metric: p95_latency_ms
scale_down_threshold: 200
scale_up_threshold: 350
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 40
target_gpu_util_pct: 65-75
concurrent_token_limit_per_replica: 1200
```
soak: 30m at each ramp step, smoke after scale events.

dmitri_eng: On the model side we'll prime KV cache and prefix caches. Recommend running prefix-replay + cache-priming for 12h prior to first step. Also preparing a fallback policy: if p95 > 800ms for >10m, shift 20% to smaller quantized variant and drop batch size by 25%.

amanda_cs: Good. Fallback needs to be explicit in the runbook. Add rollback play: immediate traffic cut to 0% followed by manual triage if errors spike.

marisol_csm: Vanguard asked about billing visibility during warmup. Ops: can we tag warmup traffic so they don't get billed at regular production rates? @ben_sre

ben_sre: We can add a request header x-vanguard-warmup:true and filter in billing pipeline. I will add tagging to the load generator and gate the quota increase on that header present.

deploy-bot: loadtest-runner started: job id lt-2026-03-21-01, profile=vanguard-warmup, step=1 (5%), target_qps=500

ben_sre: starting step 1. Watch the dashboard: token_service p95, gpu_util, queue_depth. I’ll annotate the runbook with thresholds.

amanda_cs: preflight checklist (short):
- quota request submitted + provision ID
- reserve capacity (dedicated pool allocation)
- autoscaler config pushed (ben)
- KV/prefix priming window scheduled (dmitri)
- customer comms + paging (marisol)
- tagging for billing (ben)
- fallback policies in place and tested (dmitri/ben)

marisol_csm: Vanguard confirmed reserve ID RSRV-8742 and gave a maintenance window 02:00–08:00 UTC for heavy cache priming.

ben_sre: Step 1 complete: p95=220ms, gpu_util=26%, no errors. Advancing to step 2 after 45min soak.

marisol_csm: Vanguard wants a simple one-page summary for execs after ramp completion with colors: green=on-target, amber=degraded, red=critical. I'll draft template.

dmitri_eng: quick note on priming scripts — use the prefix-replay tool with these flags:
```bash
./prefix-replay --source=vanguard-samples.tar.gz \
  --concurrency=80 --duration=12h --tag x-vanguard-warmup:true
```
Please ensure logs are routed to their project folder.

ben_sre: observed transient queue spikes during a scale event at step 3. Adjusted scale_up cooldown to 45s and dropped batch size target by 10%. Monitoring.

amanda_cs: capture that in runbook as "scale-event mitigation". Also, add a postmortem checkpoint at 72h to review token-usage drift and billing tag fidelity.

deploy-bot: loadtest-runner note: job lt-2026-03-21-01 step=3 completed, avg_qps=3120, errors=0.

marisol_csm: Vanguard asked if we can pre-warm embeddings store too (they use hybrid reranking). Dmitri can you add that to priming?

dmitri_eng: yes, will trigger embeddings prefetch after step 4. ETA: start at T+30h.

amanda_cs: owners: ben (autoscale + tagging), dmitri (priming + fallback variants), marisol (customer comms + paging). I'll own runbook + final go/no-go. Next sync in 2h — please update the shared doc with timestamps for each action.

ben_sre: noted. Posting runbook PR now -> link: https://redwood.internal/runs/rsrv-8742/warmup-runbook

marisol_csm: added Vanguard contact and paging roster to doc. Lee.v oncall: +1 555-0199.

amanda_cs: thanks team. If anything slips, call @here. :thumbsup:
